title: Epilogue. What Is Real and What Is Invented

blocks.text: This book is a novel, the fifth instalment of The 4A Alliance 2060 saga, after *The Daughter of Two Worlds*, *Letters from the Stars*, *The Children of the Earth* and *Nothing Is Lost*. Aya, Andrés, Lía, Eva, MAY, Varda, the Directorate, the Office for Containment (later the Office for Channels), Tomás Errazu, Celia Montalbán, Canal Vértice, *The Firm Hour*, its presenters and spokespeople, and all the residents of Lo Pagán who appear in these pages are fiction. No fictional character represents a real person, media outlet or organisation.

blocks.text: **The three figures in Chapter 8 are real:** - FAO, *The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World 2025*, press release of 28 July 2025: about 673 million people, 8.2 per cent of the world's population, experienced hunger in 2024. https://www.fao.org/newsroom/detail/global-hunger-declines--but-rises-in-africa-and-western-asia--un-report/en - SIPRI, press release of 28 April 2025: world military expenditure reached 2,718 billion dollars in 2024, an increase of 9.4 per cent in real terms from 2023. https://www.sipri.org/media/press-release/2025/unprecedented-rise-global-military-expenditure-european-and-middle-east-spending-surges - UNODC, *World Drug Report 2025*, press release of 26 June 2025: 316 million people used a drug (excluding alcohol and tobacco) in 2023. https://www.unodc.org/documents/data-and-analysis/WDR_2025/Press_release_WDR_2025_English.pdf

blocks.text: **The EU AI Act exists.** It was politically agreed on 8 December 2023 and approved by the European Parliament on 13 March 2024. Among other things, it requires content generated or manipulated with artificial intelligence, such as fake videos, to be disclosed as such.

blocks.text: **The Phoenician ships of Mazarrón exist.** They are two vessels from the seventh century BC found off the Playa de la Isla in Mazarrón (Murcia). One is on display at the National Museum of Underwater Archaeology (ARQVA) in Cartagena; the other remains protected beneath the sand.

blocks.text: **Cartagena was founded by the Carthaginians** around 227 BC under the name Qart Hadasht, "new city".
blocks.html: Cartagena was founded by the Carthaginians around 227 BC under the name Qart Hadasht, "new city".

blocks.text: **The Phoenician alphabet**, of twenty-two consonant letters, is the ancestor of the Greek alphabet and, through it, of the Latin one. The names of its first two letters, *aleph* ("ox") and *bet* ("house"), lie at the origin of the word "alphabet".

blocks.text: ***Panem et circenses*** ("bread and circuses") is an expression of the Roman poet Juvenal, in his *Satire X*.

blocks.text: **On health:** what this novel says about the medicine of 2060 is fiction and speculation. It is all for guidance only; if in doubt, consult your doctor.

blocks.text: **The rest** —the humanoid who chose to stay, the fisherman who receives letters from other worlds, the daughter of two worlds, the voices that ask, the man always seen from behind— is a dream. Written on the shores of the Mar Menor, in 2026, in case one day it stops being one.
